TWO_PI = 2*np.pi
def Nsm(t):
    u = np.asarray(t, float)/TWO_PI
    return u*np.log(u) - u + 7/8
def dNsm(t): return np.log(np.asarray(t, float)/TWO_PI)/TWO_PI
def smooth_zero(n):

def Nfl(t, P):
    return -sum(np.sin(m*t*np.log(pp))/(m*pp**(m/2)) for pp in P for m in (1, 2, 3))/np.pi
